name: Webster Town Hall and connected former Bartlett / Sitkowski School
appearanceBasis: Brick wall material is supported by public exterior photographs and the Town Hall preservation RFP. Approximate color matches the original photo-inferred front facade; procedural joints are a modeled finish, not a surveyed brick pattern.
photoReview: NPS nomination photos 18 and 23, Albert Rex, August 2009: brick Town Hall rear-side and auditorium connector; pale quoins, frieze, cornice, window accents and arched doorway. These are dated exterior references, not a 2026 survey.
selectionBasis: Only vertical triangles along the original shared building footprint in the neutral source body. Inclusive triangle ranges are pinned to each source GLB; neighboring buildings, roof caps, front overlays, pale trim, cupola and stone remain unchanged.
